title: Photographic era visual-semantics and candidate-pack strengthening proposal

decision.rationale: Authoritative process, conservation, photographic-history, manufacturer, archive, and computational-photography sources support an 18-profile, 23-family design. Shared runtime assets and indexes remain unchanged, so no routing, prompt, render, or user-success claim is made.

source_conversation.title: 사진 촬영 시대별 특징 조사
source_conversation.role: keyword-scope input, not prevalence or provenance evidence

pixel_eligible: support, binder, image-layer, mount, case, and complete object boundaries
spatially owned optical, exposure, tonal, and color relations
print, slide, newsprint, screen, and social-frame output containers
localized material deterioration with an unaffected comparison region
composition, camera position, subject action, and visible scene topology
metadata_only: photographer, owner, publisher, or archive identity
exact camera, sensor, lens, film stock, lab, or algorithm
publication, deletion, upload, and account history

gap_summary: era-facing candidates are mostly isolated labels rather than source-bound process-object-response relations
sepia currently conflates a color treatment with age
capture-time response, output-container traces, deterioration, and retro simulation are not consistently separated
historical processes before roll film lack dedicated five-component visual contracts
platform aspect ratio and product names can be mistaken for capture-era proof

activation_policy.hard_profile_eligible: only an exact, narrow, context-complete phrase naming all five observable component groups and remaining compatible with frozen user intent
activation_policy.bare_era_or_decade: candidate-family discovery only; zero hard profiles
activation_policy.brand_model_stock_or_project_name: explicit metadata or bounded look candidate only; zero hard profiles by itself
activation_policy.broad_vintage_retro_film_old_photo: clarification or candidate advisory only; zero hard profiles
activation_policy.bm25f_or_embedding_only: advisory retrieval only and never hard evidence
activation_policy.primary_owner_rule: each visible relation has one primary profile owner; adjacent profiles may contribute only non-conflicting components
activation_policy.dual_time_rule: record depicted or requested scene time separately from the time whose visual look is being simulated
activation_policy.adult_subject_boundary: if a person is visible, describe only observable adult appearance and action; do not infer identity, protected traits, health, attractiveness, occupation, nationality, ethnicity, or relationship

candidate_pack_policy.candidate_shape: source-bound families composed across process, object, response, practice, output, deterioration, retro-simulation, and scene-prior lanes
selection_order: explicit user process and physical output
forbidden_automatic_bundles: old photo plus sepia plus grain plus scratches plus light leak
1970s plus yellow cast plus instant border plus 110 blur
1990s plus date stamp plus disposable flash as a universal stack
2000s plus CCD purple fringe as device proof
2010s plus square crop as capture-date proof
candidate_pack_policy.candidate_pack_array_boundary: generated candidate packs are arrays; validation must inspect .[0] or iterate all documents before asserting candidate exposure

components: complete glossy or resin-coated consumer print

components: phone-close camera position or a foreground-to-distance action path

shadow detail is clean enough to read

components: bright sources are not broadly clipped
dark surfaces retain color and structure

render_gates: source cores and adjacent detail coexist
moving edges avoid broad ghost duplication

components: physical silver-gelatin print or negative support
